name: io.github.stefanbackor/edupage-keyring-mcp
title: EduPage Keyring
description: EduPage timetables, grades, homework and messages; session in the OS Credential Store, no password.

packageArguments.name: --school
packageArguments.description: Your school: the name before .edupage.org, or its EduPage address. Repeat for more schools. Claude opens EduPage's sign-in page in Chrome when needed.

environmentVariables.name: EDUPAGE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only to keep two EduPage accounts at the same school apart. The password is never configured.
